{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check the distribution of patient_id duplicates
dup_counts = data['patient_id'].value_counts()
dup_patients = dup_counts[dup_counts > 1].index
print(f'Duplicate patient IDs: {len(dup_patients)} patients with multiple rows')

# Check the sample_seq values for duplicate patients
dup_data = data[data['patient_id'].isin(dup_patients)]
print('\nSample_seq distribution for duplicate patients:')
dup_data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].apply(list).head(10)"}
